KeysToEntries.EA8878434BB2EDF9AD2F6F82F8F6D8F2: If you’re here to complain about the water, join the club. I’ve been fielding complaints all day. Something is definitely up with it, and I need some help to sort it out.
KeysToEntries.8CC296B544B6A18843CEF3B4642EF68D: It’s always one thing after another with this place.
KeysToEntries.D784EC654A3003D43664778BB6E96A72: I’ve put up a reward for anyone who can get me a sample from the supply water intake. The sooner the better.
KeysToEntries.6226D3DB4F707EBCC0D4F79069B4D398: Thanks. I’ll have Lance take a look at this immediately.
KeysToEntries.3EB89D97444FA6F1CC987C8DD01BF847: I’m not saying our water’s been tampered with, but based on your samples, I can’t rule out the possibility either. Would you return to the Dam and see what’s wrong?
KeysToEntries.FD97E80841A28FB6B0B9BF9138580151: I had Lance run some tests on the water sample you brought back, and the results are not great. This goes beyond natural contaminants.
KeysToEntries.3A981F4245EA45C0A0132DA3812AC68E: You found something? Oh. This is bad.

KeysToEntries.BC29642E466CD12D058A208943D27FD8: Go to the tunnels beneath the Spaceport; there should be a valve to reroute the water. Make sure you dodge ARC on the way there.

KeysToEntries.A84ABA5F4638DA4461B8B8A5F9D53A8F: See, I have a friend on the surface. Guy keeps pigeons for communication, but it’s been a while since I received any. Could you check it out?

KeysToEntries.898A22D946E187EF189DAFA42DD3EC20: I see. Flown the coop, has he? Life in Toledo might not be for everyone, but it sure beats the alternative… Thank you.
KeysToEntries.E84E7EF44F3D993D716302BC52A82F24: A Raider came into my shop earlier, to trade some grenades for a machine she found in Buried City. She said it makes coffee, but it seems to be missing a few parts. Up for a job?

KeysToEntries.BA1148494D2BEDC35376EDB71D3D58B4: There should be plenty of cafes in the Buried City where you can search for the parts.
KeysToEntries.732CF7384D8C2B74C10858AA1334C1D5: Thank you! Once I figure out how to brew a cup of espresso, you’ll be the first to know.

KeysToEntries.460BBEDF44F2D00CAC9F929BE4A0E071: You’ll probably find a football in the galleria in Buried City, though other places might be safer. Your choice.
KeysToEntries.21BAA4D8439F10675FB85BB96B9D2EE7: Fantastic. Now I just need to field a team. Actually, make that two.

KeysToEntries.F9AE18414E66B7164DF8BB9C84DCED07: If you run out of bullets, there's often ways to improvise; provided you're creative enough.
KeysToEntries.2EC43A2D4F3C2553B3C1B3A43F39625E: Those Hornet stings can really mess you up, if you’re unlucky. And even if you destroy one, you’re still wasting a ton of ammo. I’ve been working on a more elegant way to bring them down. Care to make some sparks fly?
KeysToEntries.05493CC44801060AA3CB2EAF3E07BCEB: Appreciate it. I’ve heard Wasp Drivers and Fireball Burners can be repurposed to do some serious damage.
KeysToEntries.A9A156B74A6B0988F2CAB4AD0F9575D8: Those ARC parts did some serious damage, huh? That opens up a lot of possibilities.
KeysToEntries.CC211D434D9DBF80C0A941B14C4ABF60: So, the OTTM had a mole problem, and they’re a lot smaller and a lot weaker than they present themselves.
KeysToEntries.993F9A5E4C75DB139E3E898AE5BFFA01: The only thing official about the OTTM is how they slapped ‘official’ on their name and hoped no one would question it.
KeysToEntries.59C9565744D392380A54948F6BD8D53D: Thanks. Check around the generators for the Dam, and see if you can’t scrounge up a Power Rod. We’ll try to pass it off as one of ours.
KeysToEntries.338AB3DD474BA9FEB01AE590D4B9C297: The alley behind the houses should be the quickest way to get inside. There’s a sort of indoor courtyard there that would be the likeliest place to hide something in plain sight.
KeysToEntries.E24AD6A844182A97FFCF9490A9892CF3: Good. Break open any Probe or Courier you see on the surface, and report back what you found inside.
KeysToEntries.DFCE4CB64A58D0BD731618800FF3B444: The Official Toledo Tubes Management is demanding one of our Power Rods for usage of “their” Slingshot tubes. Don’t let the name fool you, they’re in no way official; just thugs with lots of power. Could you help me with this?
KeysToEntries.C3639B6D4D5DB435060D15821457B4C6: Good. Hopefully those thugs won’t be able to tell the difference between this rod and our own. I’ll have Apollo take a look at this before sending it off.
KeysToEntries.1C52C1594314A535F6276AA7E60AAB19: Bees! There are bees still around! While I’m no expert, our greenhouse crew desperately wants some.
KeysToEntries.5F48A9C446D0181BCB67FE88DD337430: I heard stories of bees when I was a kid. They fly around and help plants grow even better. Nasty sting though, but potentially worth it if we can use them to improve our crops.
KeysToEntries.28FE47114F19EC5EDF25A69D83C7D0F8: Even the slightest change to ARC's behavior could spell disaster. And that signal you heard? It's like nothing we've ever picked up. If they're up to something, we need to find out whatever we can.
KeysToEntries.10AEEDE341D858E5E442C9A675675E24: We caught a break. One of our scouts saw a member of the Tubes Management make a dead drop inside the Santa Maria Houses in Buried City. This might be our chance to dig up some dirt on them for a change. You in?
KeysToEntries.242ED2014C1D84AB202AA8ACFA57B35E: Raider, I can't thank you enough. This info will allow me to secure free access to the Tubes moving forward. Now, I just need to subtly drop the hint that I've got something they’d rather keep under wraps…
KeysToEntries.C8B5E31D474C6E503641E787F834BA36: Thanks, that's a good first step. I'm sure there'll be plenty more to uncover, so feel free to drop by again.
KeysToEntries.79E469994C7B52BB2BBAFBA6D3052B13: Say, newbie: if you want me to treat you, you better prove that those precious limbs of yours are worth bandaging.
KeysToEntries.C647CD6B46EB32AB0C5B2C9AF02D8C20: Got your gun ready, Raider? Do keep your wits about you when you take on ARC. Too much noise, and you'll attract unwanted attention. And don’t forget to grab the alloy from the machines you bring down.
KeysToEntries.07A47FA446C8208E52AC0AB64C55A2DB: Well done, the skies are a bit clearer. The parts found in these drones can be quite useful. Have you upgraded your workstations yet?
KeysToEntries.192FCEEE4BE927677935F7A1070A94F7: Take down a few of the machines, and grab some ARC Alloy from their wrecks. I’d go for the small ones; no offense.
KeysToEntries.83C0B8CF4D33E27DDB5F9F9EEF44F3CB: Great. There’s a Baron husk near the Spaceport walls, and one in the swamp by the Dam.
KeysToEntries.49D7E7F342A2D325D3257CA1522860B4: Thanks. Surveyors are particularly skittish, so I'd suggest you find a way to stun them before engaging.
KeysToEntries.398C024F4E3377F360406DA25F517327: Go show them what you’re made of, and bring me back some trophies as proof.
KeysToEntries.5F6E281F440AA8A127A1938344CA4DCD: It’s not often I get my hands on Surveyor data, but I'd bet my hat this is tied to that signal we heard before. We’ll get to deciphering; thanks, Raider.
KeysToEntries.F18A130B40A86C3F4F2D198FC0F4AB38: Intel’s all well and good, but it only gets us so far. If ARC’s truly closing in, I need every Raider to prove they can handle their drones in a fight.
KeysToEntries.309744B644D57780DBA34E9CE41136A5: Surveyors are full of rare ARC tech, so we might both come out of this ahead.
KeysToEntries.EC5B10F74A90E6522844C985399B5715: Those LiDAR scanners you found work best when put in a high locations. I’ve identified a few good spots around the Rust Belt; hope you’re surefooted.
KeysToEntries.905A98DC4B8650AF1868EA86967EA72C: Remember, Raider: you can wander around until you stumble upon what you need, or you can learn how to recycle and take matters into your own hands.
KeysToEntries.BBBD9F6F44E35EE5004FA1AAFBDEC237: Have you spotted any Surveyors; the big round ones? They seem to be transmitting data back into orbit, and I can’t help but think it's tied to that signal we picked up. Will you break one open, so we can try to decipher the data?
KeysToEntries.DFC21FA94E10B77D1DE0B09528FBE8FC: If you spot one of the Surveyors, try to stun it before you engage. They’re said to be full of rare ARC tech, so we might both come out of this ahead.
KeysToEntries.4AB803E6432C39E8CD0A73B5243621CA: There's no such thing as junk, to a Raider; just valuable materials waiting to be recycled. If you're going to amount to anything around here, you can't just wait for things to be served on a silver platter.
KeysToEntries.80A4078E41F3AC94CF2619B99A509B2E: Made it back, huh? I’ve got plenty of Heavy Ammo in stock, should you want to tear through some more ARC plating.
KeysToEntries.BA9CED7D464B8B36FE090886BF30B541: You're one of the new arrivals, right? I need a volunteer to test out this upgraded Ferro; should cut through ARC plating like butter. Go put holes in some machines, and report back to me.
KeysToEntries.D726B11F41B63B2DA6BEA8B8D68D6217: Ferros are basic, but reliable. I’ve usually got plenty in stock, though most Raiders have figured out how to craft one themselves.
KeysToEntries.D374FE1D4EEC77EB170729A8F1E6E1DB: Call a Supply Drop, then grab whatever supplies you can. I’d try to get back here through a Raider Hatch, so nobody can trace your steps.
KeysToEntries.FE87A4E44761CC961DE24BADA8B7F29B: Raiders have long reported peculiar-looking crates dropping down from malfunctioning ARC Probes. If we can figure out a way to crack them open, we might get a better understanding of what it is they’re after.
KeysToEntries.CF143DF04A33A00424669FAB1BE3DBB4: We’ve been trying to crack open those crates for ages, but so far, all of our attempts have destroyed the contents as well.
KeysToEntries.4FC33B1F4835AC5D2D8C749DCB38596D: If you spot a crate, deliver it to a nearby Field Depot. My team will take care of the rest.
KeysToEntries.939079C343EBDFC439A909BC0FA3E0ED: Thanks. We can always use more crates, by the way. Our attempts to open them have so far been… A touch too destructive.
KeysToEntries.5044447442E3F5202872F4B357499E9B: Remember, Raider: if you stumble upon a crate, deliver it to a Field Depot so we can try to crack it open.
KeysToEntries.4D22BC93457672CDC1AAD8BCA9387CD7: This your frequency, Raider? Hope you brought that Ferro I gave you: heavy ammo punches through ARC plating better than most.
KeysToEntries.923969F54E2A1043A86A2491DFF88EB2: Just so you know, Raider: they say Fireball Burners explode on impact, but Wasp Drivers need a bit more… Encouragement.
KeysToEntries.F65AE11A4A8A1926BA7E8B93205485BE: I’ve become quite crafty at weaving bandages from Fabric, but to my shame, I haven’t quite mastered weaving an x-ray machine or a pulse oximiter.
KeysToEntries.E4B2CD65480A15095F4308A439C79162: I’ll need intrepid friends like yourself, who can get me the finest medical goods Topside has to offer. Whether you want to hang them on the inside of a trench coat, is your call to make.
KeysToEntries.632FF5D641C7FDA299EB4AA79D4C687F: Not much for tea, but I can always appreciate a hot drink.
KeysToEntries.4BE255D347C242BB74660AB79EBE9607: Made it there and back, huh? That opens up endless possibilities. Just mark those medical areas with a nice big cross on your map, all right?
KeysToEntries.DDC4EE1D41F8FE034E22FF852E048F14: I found my original analyzer at a pharmacy in Buried City; see if you can find me a spare, OK friendo?
KeysToEntries.5CE3ED7E4D3062F7C149CAB96627C087: See if you can't find a spare ESR analyzer in any of the pharmacies, OK? I have a pre-painted reveal banner that depends on it.
KeysToEntries.BE2E72314DABECEF7EF3FA86C776F7EB: They’ve been making tea from candleberry leaves. To each their own, I guess.
KeysToEntries.952388DF474F52C9ECC959B2477C8FDE: No one sabotages Speranza’s drinking water on my watch.
KeysToEntries.50A5AA0146F7ECAE7125E48052AA8500: Don’t put your candles too close to any curtains, OK?
KeysToEntries.7FF93E09472066A4D8FD2FB663C19E76: Heard Ben is making his signature stew tonight - drop by the "Bocca di Lupo" if you’re curious.
KeysToEntries.8794309147AD5D13393AF6ABDB8B8BC9: Things used to be simpler back during the First Wave. Not better, necessarily; just simpler.
KeysToEntries.A073F6FA4433C6EB44E00F9CEA704199: Seeds are one part of the equation; fertilizer is the other.
KeysToEntries.D63EED15434A48C477445D86AE2D74B8: If that task’s done, I’ve got your thank-you package ready.
KeysToEntries.98715C6C48E4BAAE155BAC8198EEAE3D: One of our scouts reported some shady characters near the pipes last time they were up there, but they couldn’t get close enough to do anything about it. That must’ve been when the siphoning started.
KeysToEntries.267CBC7B4F4630E2C23D6AA8A61B7B02: Nice work! I can’t say for sure, but I have a gut feeling someone from Toledo is behind this. I’ll have Shani check it out.
KeysToEntries.97B6D5854178719851BAE8AC7018327A: Another day, another water crisis. I was hoping that our troubles were at an end after we rerouted to the Spaceport, but now Shani suspects someone has been siphoning our water.
KeysToEntries.8D30947245E07D997D661C96D3DA87A6: Remember to get evidence of the siphoning before you fix it. But make sure you definitely fix it.
KeysToEntries.1A52634246BC4D50D3D20EB8772FC8B5: You know, I have been meaning to hang a "Best Clinic in Toledo" sign in here. Might have to make my own.
KeysToEntries.A1BC878043A384BDC3D20E96B7E2555D: Better to spend cash on repairing a shield than to spend cash on extracting bullets.
KeysToEntries.B041055B41C67AC3E446ABB23B493F60: I saw this old advert that said “The only way to cure a broken heart is to see the bottom of the ice cream container”. Ahh, one can only hope that the sight can soothe this broken heart.
KeysToEntries.11BFB77D4A5A41C38A89A291EEBDCEDE: Hey-hey! You got ‘em! They look perfect. I’m going to glue them onto a big piece of paper and write “Prom?” on it. I saw it in an old movie, seemed like a human thing to do.
KeysToEntries.185D0A7B41882F979966A3B97A34BE52: Just thinking about her got me all a-jitter. I’d blush if I could.
KeysToEntries.5979273B47AAA01D975CA3A8FC4D690E: Once upon a time there was a handsome, yet lonely android. He met a cute engineer, who would come by his clinic to patch up a scratch or two. Now he wants to get a gift for said engineer.
KeysToEntries.E8F044B44FF0D78BEC3D3D900D072B99: I want you to snap me a pic of some real pretty vistas I’ve scoped out across the Rust Belt. I’m making a collage.
KeysToEntries.8A21C13747D96BC4AE5766936341867B: So here’s the deal, you go get me a big tub of ice cream that I can drown my sorrows in.
KeysToEntries.75B350094D9FF4BC01F3699B65F33528: Task done and no one exploded? Color me impressed and confused.
KeysToEntries.003F51B243E495FF4B2F7686BB4EB5E0: Worst thing imaginable happened. Turns out that engineer does not feel the same way about your dear pal Lance. I am genuinely heartbroken, except I don’t technically have a heart.
KeysToEntries.DFA88D294DB35E4747E6829E4F2AD218: Well, chief, that there is an empty ice cream container. How am I supposed to eat ice cream if there is none? You know what, just seeing the bottom counts. My broken heart is healed. Thanks, pal!
KeysToEntries.BA5D59F84D8E4397CB9EFFB06E84E7BA: Keep an eye out for ice cream containers. My eyes are welling up with blue as we speak.
KeysToEntries.835BA4504502DD45BFB762AADD805863: This one’s in the Pattern House, by the Dam. Get the comms and power working, and I’ll do the rest from down here.
KeysToEntries.E80265ED42738430822DEE9F640D10E4: The sooner we get the outpost set up, the better. I’m not ready to give up on Topside, and neither should you.
KeysToEntries.A07ECE3C4549449A42DF7581B24DB6FA: A Leaper. Raiders much more experienced than you have tried to take one on, and very few returned in one piece.
KeysToEntries.6262F0BA4DCD3EAAE7C7BDB0DF3AC8F9: Did you see the flags? The time for cowering is over. You’ve been more than battle-tested, from what I hear; think you can take on a Rocketeer?
KeysToEntries.4ABC0A4C4AD9D9010FA7F5B980950368: A Surveyor; full of rare tech, that one. They're often more scared of you than you are of them, but in a panic, they'll bulldoze you all the same
KeysToEntries.C9D2117B4AFDA00481503DA0D4500D3A: It used to be their world, up there. Nobody to challenge their claim. Yet here we are. More outposts. More intel. More firepower. If I didn’t know better, I’d say we’ve got quite a bit of fight left in us.
KeysToEntries.4676FE2E4F7ADEB7CFA046AF40D81E38: There’s not many Raiders who’ve faced a Leaper and lived. Yet here you stand; battered but victorious. We won't forget.
KeysToEntries.F975D2174AFCC7352D5C57A0E89C9CBD: It used to be madness, to take on a Leaper head-on. But now? I think we might just have what it takes.
KeysToEntries.EC371172479E9AF3262CB6BD6EDCEA95: A Pop. Not much survival instinct in those, but they'll do whatever they can to take you down with them.
KeysToEntries.4B3C9091492F0E8536A147836D9AF360: You'll have to be quick on your feet, Raider, because the Leaper does not take any prisoners. Remember the flags: stand tall, and stand proud.
KeysToEntries.DFA645344800A4A83D8FE58A57C5119A: Excellent. I know one outpost may seem like a small step, but every building we claim is proof that we’re not giving up on Topside.
KeysToEntries.D7F1ACA1473C69C8344A11AE1E9CBF44: ARC may be changing, but we’re finally changing with it. Let’s finish up those outposts so we can track them; flank them; smash them to bits.
KeysToEntries.0DCE75494C4AFB19CD76338B37FD1884: Managed to crack open an armored transport, huh? That’s promising. Very promising.
KeysToEntries.C229109745FD797D1FA109B093D20B8F: If this is your idea of a dramatic pause, I'm not a fan.
KeysToEntries.90DD13FE483BFF3626A5469EC8BE2436: There’s some armored transports among the pileup by the gate. Find a way in, and see what you can find.
KeysToEntries.7F7127FF46F630443AF6959930C07AA7: As excited as I am about this, we can’t forget that any topside presence is risky. Keep it simple: paint, move on, next building. Quick work.
KeysToEntries.0DCB3C864EBA739F5C87DF9661B3D210: Ever since we expanded the tunnels to the Blue Gate, some rare pieces have started appearing on the black market. Meanwhile, I'm stuck here peddling battered old Rattlers. If I don't find new supply lines, I'll be left in the dust.
KeysToEntries.A14CB765489D0C267C82D9A9A3FF789C: Normally I wouldn’t bother with something as dull as greenhouses, but the abysmal state of our kitchens is getting to me.
KeysToEntries.D22FEED1406EA982B33809BCCFC2C389: After the machines returned and forced us underground , the camps fell into disrepair, and now Raiders have picked most of them clean. I want you to scout a few for me.
KeysToEntries.74CDF1BF4E71B7FAEE65DA97CB11E3C1: Here’s a list of buildings that could make for potential outposts. Mark them with paint for us, so the crews know where to go.
KeysToEntries.5E9FE0FF4E1F02D43798889FA3D319DC: If there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that locked doors tend to guard the tastiest hauls.
KeysToEntries.25D4A51A4E311A2AD4399C8D5C3A4CD5: I’m setting up a greenhouse, to help boost our food production. I’m doing Celeste a solid, alright? That’s all. But enough about that. I’ve got all the details worked out, but I’ll need supplies, and I’m not hauling them alone.
KeysToEntries.7A14F1E543A5BE23C8B4CB830960DF31: Between what I have and what I can build, I’ve got most of it covered. What I still need from you is fertilizer, a water pump, and a humidifier. Shouldn’t be too hard to find, I hope.
KeysToEntries.45A37CE347A9EAC4A8A40DAA1F047C62: That’s everything I asked for. I’ll handle the rest.
KeysToEntries.088DDE454CE8D2C578E17CBDB5AB48A1: Celeste told me you’re the one who helped her hound me about pitching in more. I’ll say this once: I don’t appreciate the meddling, and I have my own reasons for refusing. I do, however, appreciate the scrap. Since you’re apparently good at tracking it down, I may have a task for you.
KeysToEntries.E3CA95064060149933BF90A1FDDAF46C: People sheltered in those camps, back then. Used the outposts to send messages and keep an eye on the ARC movements. Nothing like now.
KeysToEntries.280AC1874D39529BB96F2E96ED467315: I see. You can keep everything you found—just don’t tell Celeste you’ve been rummaging around them on my behalf, alright? I don’t need her to breathe down my neck. I have some other places in mind too, so come back soon if you want to pocket some more coin.
KeysToEntries.7D14AD98478D44763BFE0AA73E1AED1E: You marked them? Perfect. Those marks will hold until we’ve got boots on the ground. …Man, new outposts.
KeysToEntries.65B4039A428E2CFCE68BCCA391D50DF1: Guess what? Shani asked me to help out with something, and for once, I’m actually glad she did. We’re setting up new outposts topside! Or, planning to, at least. Can you believe it?
KeysToEntries.E05B1E054D1627410F9D9CA905A9F4C3: The armored transports are in the car pileup by the gate, but they seem to be locked with a key card of sorts. You’ll find a way in, I’m sure.
KeysToEntries.EC5B91FC4A16A7E7325927BCD70DD53C: Raider camps come in all shapes and sizes. If you spot a shack made of mostly corrugated sheets, that’s probably one of ours.
KeysToEntries.7CD30F3446EACD2517EA228FF4BCEB36: I have another special site I need you to search for me. An old battlegrounds, from the First Wave. Raiders nowadays usually pick places like that clean, despite the significance they once held. People forget quickly. Quicker than they should.
KeysToEntries.7BDE66D14A515F95D9E6D8BAFD86DBF7: About the site… I can’t expect you to actually care. But try to be respectful, at least.
KeysToEntries.257275F24E28D5F4595624AE4046CE6E: If it looks like it mattered to someone, grab it. Don’t break it. This isn’t salvage.
KeysToEntries.6094B53348B12F1F857588A9BF108A1A: I have to admit I didn’t expect much to be left. Maybe people missed these, or maybe they didn’t care. It’s not what I’m looking for, but I appreciate it. I’ll make sure they’re looked after properly.
KeysToEntries.E59B827049397D2152B6A4BFD1C1DC43: Remember, you’re looking for a First Wave battleground. There might be junk around, but look for anything that stands out.
KeysToEntries.D0C431DA482E048DE08AA69342D66B8C: Someone has been lifting supplies from my drop-off point in Buried City. I’ve set up a trap, but I need someone to check it for me.
KeysToEntries.D8E5C4E144F61E8BC9996AB61CD7163E: Could be a rival arms dealer from Toledo poking around my cache. Keep your wits about you, just in case.
KeysToEntries.7F8A4876489AD24DF541108FA5703545: Good. Stake out the area. Catch them in the act, or track them back to where they’re stashing my goods.
KeysToEntries.B69FCEE54669BB5BDDDEA7B35FB67172: Huh. I suppose they won’t be stealing from me again, at least. By the way, keep this between us. My drop-offs aren’t exactly sanctioned by Celeste.
KeysToEntries.9079D2AA4EA895BEC16438B5D5D7F212: My drop-off cache is on the outskirts of the city. Look for some warehouses, and you should be able to find it. I’ve rigged the trap with tracing color, so if it went off then whoever triggered it should’ve left plenty of marks behind.
KeysToEntries.4F80917349C15912A783AE9797D275B8: That theft before? Doesn’t look like a coincidence anymore. Some of the competition from Toledo is setting up shop where they don’t belong. I want their cache sabotaged, preferably before they get too comfortable.
KeysToEntries.8BC754DE4A244FB10CD2F1A817160250: Most Toledo caches are packed with low-grade weapons. Taking some out of circulation is a community service.
KeysToEntries.EF9D8B8A4444470C438F28B19918899B: Find their cache, and deal with it. Make sure they think twice before trying again. My sources tell me it’s somewhere near the station, so start there.
KeysToEntries.7CF7BBE34A70B931CBB93E92604EE66F: Good job taking care of their cache. That’s one less problem off my plate.
KeysToEntries.CBDB203D4F421D42BE7D9983D986F706: Everything’s been calm around my drop-offs since you helped out, but that doesn’t mean it’ll stay that way for long. I’ve set up surveillance at one of my most used spots in Buried City, to prevent future tampering. Only problem is, it needs power to go live.
KeysToEntries.3E04798742484250AB5481A51A8160D3: The solar panels are by a roof terrace, south of the Southern Station. No one will notice some discreet rewiring.
KeysToEntries.A20AFF414B01984F5EDEBCB1C0E82D73: There’s a secluded solar panel near the Southern Station in Buried City. Go there, rewire the junction, and tie it into my setup.
KeysToEntries.698D5CD44FDDDD627E02D49684254B4B: Nice. With this surveillance, I can keep an eye on my stashes. Thanks for helping out.
KeysToEntries.81E583A54BE5A4B575E9329E4E32CBC0: You’ll find the solar panel by a nice secluded roof terrace, near the Southern Station. Look for blue tarps. Rewire it so my surveillance gets priority. The rest of the grid can go dark, for all I care.
KeysToEntries.F418BFFD4A69D8E675A3648462EDB961: Back during the First Wave, my squad and I built a trap out by the Dam. Overloaded a generator, turned it into a makeshift ARC trap. Now I hear Raiders are using it to cut comms and spring ambushes on each other. I need you to end it.
KeysToEntries.8189EA1E48F8A3412D12E88811C077A5: We built that trap right when we thought we were done for. It was crude, but it saved our lives. I can’t stand knowing it’s out there, being used like this.
KeysToEntries.0F00F0504AFCF39762894585029DF96F: Head out there and kill the power, pull the plug—do whatever it takes to shut it down. That trap was built to keep us safe, not for us to use against each other.
KeysToEntries.0F14FD2E463C7F04D1D95EBB4A7427FD: Thanks for handling that. That thing wasn’t built to last, and it sure as hell wasn’t supposed to be used for something like this. Damn fools should’ve known better.
KeysToEntries.FF89434D49CBD865CF6074B4B1C889FA: Be on the lookout for that trap, Raider. It looks... Just as high-voltage as you'd imagine.
KeysToEntries.647FBBE2415C12076B014FB969A932CF: I lost my cool a bit when I sent you after that trap. I don’t usually lose my temper, but the First Wave… We went through a lot, back then. Lost a lot of people. It’s still a bit of a raw wound for me, but I want you to understand.
KeysToEntries.91529AAB4AEB0BCFED8588B554BFA4A0: I wish we had the resources to teach everyone about what it was like, back then. Why this all matters.
KeysToEntries.765A4A75427B1347EAF6CA82015E4037: There’s an old memorial for the people we lost.  I’d like you to drop by, make sure it’s all still standing. Maybe it’ll all make more sense once you’ve seen it yourself.
KeysToEntries.F4CB5AFD44BCD4B7880E4EBEEFCECF14: So you saw it, then. Still standing? Good. Maybe it doesn’t look like much, but the First Wave resistance deserves to be remembered.
KeysToEntries.C2A0946048A40DDEA4BB13901B9F9EAA: Did you feel any tremors last night? Me neither. But apparently the ground shifted at some point, and in the process it unearthed an old First Wave outpost that’d been blocked by debris. I’d like you to get in there quick, before anyone else does.
KeysToEntries.2371B3624ED4B616BDC84892F9F28793: Did you check out the old outpost yet? I’d rather get it done quickly, before others start picking it clean.
KeysToEntries.7D948B064E67F5E0407875864B8CC7BA: Good. It’s out on the Dam, by the old ridge. Head straight there, if you can. Bring back anything significant, but if you see any battle plans, those would be invaluable.
KeysToEntries.7B392CBB48BD67D9583C1CAFCC16E57B: …So no plans, then. Shame. Still, you didn’t come back empty-handed. I’m grateful. I’ll make sure this ends up where it should be.
KeysToEntries.51A122C2422FEB5A1F5A98B644EF8B4B: I'll be honest, Raider: we called it an outpost, but it was more of a hideout, really. See if the tremors revealed any of our old battle plans. We need to learn from the past now more than ever.
KeysToEntries.EEEAF2AF41B0F7C295AF40A40B3A2575: Y’know, back in the day we actually used to have a flag - well, a scrap of cloth more than anything. Still, seeing it meant you knew you had allies nearby, that you were on your own home turf. So, I was thinking…
KeysToEntries.937C412B414B0E0B2F72C3BEEF1A2320: We were more united, back during the First Wave. We had to be, when the machines came down. Seeking shelter down here saved us, but it also made a lot of people forget what’s up there, and why it should matter to us.
KeysToEntries.CEAC50C142D32D71EC41BF9CCB6BE47B: You catch on quickly. Hoist it where people can see it, alright? Doesn’t have to be flashy; a small reminder is enough.
KeysToEntries.564231E24289D177ABB12CB1412FCABB: Hoist those flags up high, where people can see. Let them remember what it felt like to stand side by side.
KeysToEntries.1F4C93D14D8FE2D6C63EAA8FE73269A9: Okay, so this is awkward… I lost two of my journals during some outpost inspections last time I went topside. Could you head out there and try to find them, before someone else stumbles on them?
KeysToEntries.4C61447249F1DC878E4B8C87D7764DDE: Don’t ask me how I lost them—I set them down, got distracted, and only realised I didn’t have them anymore when I got back here. People always tell me I shouldn’t bring my journals topside, but that’s where all the best ideas and musings happen!
KeysToEntries.1C26564B463BB49DEF5432B78ABFF678: They should be in an outpost out on the Dam; at least I hope so. Bring both back, and we’ll pretend I never lost them.
KeysToEntries.33D413784987F2BAA3E3868836AF877F: Oh, thank goodness; you found them. You just saved me a whole heap of embarrassment. Let’s never speak of this again, yeah?
KeysToEntries.137AB2674DD524A2DF68EF8DDAE0BB96: I can't believe I'm saying this, but: don’t forget to mark out those houses Shani picked, if you’re in the area!
KeysToEntries.79EE7E604E45F503F26F2DB42C4431D3: To see neighbors gathering around a shared dinner… Makes you wonder why it can’t be like this every day.
KeysToEntries.ABF3B06849D3F5D254889B9CEDB8CCA5: I… I suppose I wouldn’t say no to a cup of tea.
KeysToEntries.2758E5DE4C9AF24B5F0000911978A14F: Fire hazard, really. But we’ll let it slide.
KeysToEntries.1EBCE0744BB8B9D33DA447B74956C26A: That’s hers. I can tell. I thought it’d be gone forever. You don’t know what it means to have it back. Thank you.
KeysToEntries.588AA227457D226058E783817F5739FD: Close the door, would you? The glare of candlelight is making it harder to see my screens.
KeysToEntries.7CE759A74390DB3291254A93DC628C7D: I’m not sure what’s been going on around here lately, but it’s been a long time since Celeste has asked me for a favor. You ever visit the top of the Spaceport towers? If not, do you want to?
KeysToEntries.ED547A9E49EA08E2379D93AFA7D2387E: The tech up in and around the towers tends to be sharper than what you can find elsewhere. And take a moment to appreciate the view. Not something most folks get to see, especially these days.
KeysToEntries.F073CEA9457A3CF3F8BBA89EA3B6235B: I tracked down some calibration devices, the kind you won’t just find lying around most places. If we’re lucky, they’ll be up there.
KeysToEntries.3CBB07C349F2BBD88EC7B7AF1CE0C977: Solid work. They’re even in better condition than I expected. I’m sure Celeste has... Plans for these.
KeysToEntries.65892575406BE797432B6BA0B36497FF: I know you can hear the sweet call of those calibration devices, but be careful if you’re heading up the towers. The closer you get, the more action you’re likely to find.
KeysToEntries.E3E80F1E4CF8390E0E9B10989893035D: See if you can find any traces of that family, and please hurry. They were last seen in a camp on the abandoned highway.
KeysToEntries.121F7159433CC0B33E664A80A039D6F9: See if you can get me what I need to set up a proper football league down here. I can't wait to learn how to perform a proper "Red Card".
KeysToEntries.40A6F33D45615825502D48B5240F625B: Don't forget to head to the library, Raider; I’ve been dying to read a new detective novel! I’ve read the previous one eight times now, and the butler did it every time.
KeysToEntries.1B5901D8438386770B34A78410A08C29: Take a look around the old town, if you can. Should be plenty of charming trattorias with espresso machines you can... Let's say: borrow from.
KeysToEntries.25DE10044FF9421E47B56DAC7B142F53: Good work on scoping out those salvage sites. I’ll make sure Tian Wen gets first dibs on anything good.
KeysToEntries.95B32E9A448FB4A6E66F18B6DBFB88C9: I need you to scope out these three potential salvage sites. If any of them pan out, Tian Wen may just warm up to us.
KeysToEntries.2ED5F21D408C68AB352FCDAD4F81B80C: I’ve been pestering Tian Wen for a while now, trying to get her to help out around here. Her customer service is questionable, but she’s a wizard with a wrench.
KeysToEntries.ECDD05544B0F3765D461C0813547A896: Watch your back when you're in the Power Generation Complex. I don't want my backup engineer bedridden as well.
KeysToEntries.59BEA34C47AAFAFCB361109A830D8A53: My usual engineer is still healing from his wounds, and has been loopy for days. We can’t afford to be at half-grid until he heals; I need someone to pick up his wrench in the mean time.
KeysToEntries.2BB4C2CA4B1A5361037B2B85C335B9ED: If you’re after that power rod I need, start by looking around the Generator Hall.
KeysToEntries.803065184F12B82412AB538D21A6B4D4: Recently, I’ve been trying and failing to get Tian Wen to join our community projects. I may have to sweeten the deal. She’s been complaining about the quality of salvage found on the market; think we could do her a solid?
KeysToEntries.5C03976E4095BF12AD6940AC3D9C3640: Remember, Raider: the evidence against the Tubes Management should be in the North Trench Tower. Don’t lose the key.
KeysToEntries.04F9CB0E48C6BAA088BCBFA827281DCD: There’s a Power Generation Complex by the Dam; the wounded engineer was mumbling about the Generator Room in his sleep. Never stops working, that man.
KeysToEntries.F125F3F14B15AEDDB1152696E9750F7A: The power is back at full capacity; that should buy my engineer some time to recover from his wounds. Thank you.
KeysToEntries.B5228C594F5675540DCF2AB48C813139: Just so you know: my friends stay only in the finest of accommodations! Drawers; cabinets; suitcases: you name it!
KeysToEntries.086CD8B040E7EED4EEB5FEA18999454D: The pharmacist lived near the collapsed highway; all I need are some tasteful shots for my mood board. No self-portraits, please!
KeysToEntries.A565C17647536C92957B4C93BBA78E03: Make sure you're well prepared before you face a Rocketeer head-on. Find solid cover, and aim quick and true. A single misstep can be curtains call.
KeysToEntries.89E68362464B833A6DDB67B409E1DCFE: Head to the collapsed highway, and see if you can find any traces of what caused its destruction.
KeysToEntries.B33C753A4FE88BA49941C9B9741CDE81: The equipment in Control Tower A-6 is some of the most advanced I have at my disposal. I can’t afford having a gap in my data, especially while ARC clearly has something brewing.
KeysToEntries.F930686E48079F6469C16998AAD72463: Have you seen Bilguun around at all? I’ll save him a bowl of stew–just in case.
KeysToEntries.61DB36B44707173763778FB08F02FEBD: Keep an eye out for the clogged pipe down in the tunnels. Just hold your nose and take a shower before you come back.
KeysToEntries.6D4E13AE449F6C157EDDEEAA972D5E1F: The foreman may have left notes on where to find the LiDAR scanners. See if you can find any in the Jiangsu Warehouse.

KeysToEntries.A0DD47EE473A9C2DDFED9C91D43659BF: You’ll find their cache around Marano station, marked with a ribbon. A little sabotage should do the trick.
KeysToEntries.71CB7F6D4B8F39918DBCE7BAEA095469: With my own stashes secured, I think it might be time to keep a closer eye on the competition so this doesn’t happen again.
KeysToEntries.56B63F9344D77CE16AAD34B1C1EFB9BF: Any Burletta will do. Buy one, craft one, loot one. Just don’t be stupid and put your own modified Burletta in there, if you even have one.
KeysToEntries.4A9DB34B4A54022C338E1DB29333AB3C: Go deliver a Burletta to a rival’s drop-off in Buried City; make them think you’re one of their runners. Then, plant a listening device on the cache.
KeysToEntries.52E9889B4934F860145FA69DB091D779: They’ll think twice before sniffing around my cashes again once they learn that turnabout is fair play.
KeysToEntries.25831B4641B4ADD9675170AD431D5A97: The weapon cache is near the Gas Station at the Outskirts of the town.
KeysToEntries.BC24CA7747512F93F6EEA7BC13AA9E0A: Imagine my surprise when Tian Wen decides to leave her hidey-hole to come talk to me. She admitted to rewiring solar panels for her own gain, and she even mentioned a certain Raider helping her.
KeysToEntries.95A20CAA4AFA41B188C20EB32FDCADDE: Haven’t decided if I should forgive her for actually fessing up to it, or if I should hold it over her head for a little while longer.
KeysToEntries.F62D00734AF25631055491B5BC9551B8: Go back to the rewired solar panel in Buried City and wire it back. After that, I’ll consider you and me square.
KeysToEntries.B5C9624B40EF00CA4566A4B275DFE80B: Power grid looks good again. Thanks. And fair warning, don’t try something like that again.
KeysToEntries.0701E2384A703D6E09C783B0F86FBFA4: Solar panel's still south of the Southern Station. I'm sure you remember from last time, right?
KeysToEntries.DCA733D145B9806581F602AF02AF146D: The light, the greenery…  You can almost picture us living topside again.
KeysToEntries.124E006C468A4AD311BD4AA73C3698D3: Together, we’ll get through this cold snap, too. I know it.
KeysToEntries.099C7E6348CDFC6AD9296A83C9FAEAC9: We’ve had to board up our skylights, so ARC can’t spot the glow of all these candles.
KeysToEntries.C724BA5E447319700D0963B422DBAFDC: Things have been a bit less rowdy, these days. That's something.
KeysToEntries.D470CEE94BF6D739BC767EA14D22F3F5: This scent… My father always loved tea. Brings back memories.
KeysToEntries.D9DF690C40F5DB3D282BA19945A09B0C: All Raiders: the geothermal fissures by the swamp are producing a rare microbial fertilizer. Use the antennas by the domes to disperse some of the gases, then grab as much as you can carry.
KeysToEntries.F174E4F142F5766688EFA7973842DE0D: Hello!? Does anyone hear me!? Damn it; that magnetic storm must’ve fried our radios. Will somebody please call maintenance?!
KeysToEntries.EEA1D3DD4F3344D2ACB0518235FF8705: Be aware, Raiders: ARC’s been behaving especially erratically today, and seem to be prone to escalating threats. We’ll open the Tubes back up as soon as we’ve found some pattern to this madness.
KeysToEntries.DF3993534D890D78429F1A8254A7A293: Are you enjoying yourself? Don’t forget to take some time to decompress and chase away the cold.
KeysToEntries.36E85C434D4388E383F0E0ADEE3CC1BB: Do any Raiders have eyes on the Gate? Some thugs have triggered the emergency shutdown, which can only be bad news. Find the key cards to override the protocol, so we can uncover whatever it is that can't stand the light of day.
KeysToEntries.4BB281F84AABC54F45EF2BB56082161B: Anyone near the Spaceport? Someone just managed to override the Outskirts Bunker's security system, and every gang in Toledo is scrambling to get their hands on whatever's inside. Don't let this opportunity go to waste.
KeysToEntries.71F055CA454297247FA3329F41857376: Have your eyes adjusted to the dark yet, Raider? Loot is ripe for the picking while most of Toledo is asleep, though my suppliers say that ARC is twice as vigilant after sunset.
KeysToEntries.622146A64101F127C0E2CB94AC957C79: Heads up, Raider: the dust from that storm is still settling down. ARC seems to be just as disoriented as we are, and most Raiders are holding off on going topside for a little while longer.
KeysToEntries.D7961E10462391A1A09AD69375BE7130: Make sure to take pictures of the damaged pipes, so that Shani can figure out who was behind this. Don’t forget to fix them, too.
KeysToEntries.A2AA1E2E4F53775C3E3228B0E25C7A22: There is a reservoir beneath the Spaceport; if we manage to route that water here, that should buy us time to deal with the contamination.
KeysToEntries.A2953F66419269BDC8415F9D51B4C84A: Our scouts spotted beehives on some old sheds to the south-east. There should be an olive grove around there. Perk up your ears. If you hear a buzzing noise, they can't be far away.
KeysToEntries.95A3C0804AA13E0F5F4D6B821D428F49: They were spotted near the Blue Gate. Be careful when collecting the bees, though. They can sting, and they die if they do so. We need them alive if they're to be of any use.
KeysToEntries.FE9FD47842CCC2F2C0B405BE4E1B4DCA: I know, I know! The power's down in sector—Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long. Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?
KeysToEntries.2EC8E02B474EA7CA45674792D372870A: Some scouts have been bringing back reports of these weird plants spreading into the area. Now, this makes your old pal Lance think it may have some interesting uses.
KeysToEntries.C4EBFDC449D2A24C625C7A8E1715F56B: Head out there into the Dam Battlegrounds and go get me a sample. I heard the spores themselves can be a bit toxic though, so watch out.
KeysToEntries.4492E1774919F4200E6DCC97DC065CDF: Looks like I got plenty to experiment with: these plants have somehow mutated together with fungi to form a symbiotic life form capable of spreading at record speed. My appreciations to you!
KeysToEntries.69CEEB484543E1C1D19D88931FEC5736: My mind is a-buzz with ideas of what we could do with these plants. Super fast growing foods, instant effect medicine, fun party tricks. Who knows!
KeysToEntries.D8FD27E642F716AD8D8A69A630327849: A little birdie told me they saw the plants growing on the Baron Husk out by the Old Battleground. Might be just the place to collect a sample.
KeysToEntries.BFE3D5C147A7EFB7B7E3EC99A6C8A292: Those logs were absolutely riddled with outlying data points. They might be faulty readings, of course, but they might… Not.
KeysToEntries.5AB820C7466F48FB21077C90EFC07346: Got the logs, and… There’s a lot to unpack here. We’ll need some time to go through this; get home safe, Raider.
KeysToEntries.62956DF24B0219D3967687BCD2D69BCB: You can find Rocketeers mostly anywhere, but Leapers seem to stick to the areas around the Dam and the Spaceport.
KeysToEntries.8B762EF14AADA9BC252099B8B6784B7E: A Leaper. Their stomping can be felt all the way down here. We’ll have to find a way to bring them down, before they collapse our tunnels.
KeysToEntries.D1DC6B094202C4A6F0DC4FBCDFE0A7C1: ARC's really been bringing out the big guns, lately. I need you to get some scans of a Rocketeer and a Leaper - the better we understand them, the more we can do to fight back.
KeysToEntries.46EC5EBF40ADF836E9DBB0AA71DA157D: Yellow light stick for you, my friend.
KeysToEntries.95F6C3C64A1A1D929A7E1F84AA10EF93: I’ve got the confetti cannon aimed and everything. Don’t disappoint me.
KeysToEntries.65E8C192461DB573B8A58E8FB816E280: Reward’s ready, music queued… just need your word, kid.
KeysToEntries.C3907F9E47831F7473804CBB3912D1BC: That job better be finished, because I already pre-celebrated.
KeysToEntries.F3F5F14545E6E6BFAD7BF4B8B78EE222: A balanced approach, somewhat good at penetrating ARC plating, but works well on other things too
KeysToEntries.1E380AB44A22EE90E5CC78AE6898D1A2: If you need more grenades, you can always build an Explosives Station in your workshop.
KeysToEntries.EDF438E94B0911BC73E77CAFEC82E227: Gate still standing, Raider? You'll find the unfinished structures scattered around the valley; look for construction signs and cones. My previous crew came under heavy fire before they could finish up.
KeysToEntries.13642EAB409FCF625BAE7A9C7603DACF: I heard rumors about some signal Shani picked up. ARC is constantly adapting, and I'm sure this won’t be their last warning sign. Well, if it’s an arms race they want, they can get one.
KeysToEntries.353A44A2406194DE2D49AA8655A308AE: The memorial is in the Formicai Hills, near an old First Wave wreckage. It's makeshift, just like we were, but it’s there. Make sure it’s all still standing.
KeysToEntries.5B51D7D14E755FF70A4FF89DB5ECFC10: Show me you can grab some medical supplies next time you're topside, and I'll think about whether you're worthy of my talents.
KeysToEntries.54C852F64C4906168B117C8BF509CC11: Be warned, Raiders: we've spotted more than one Queen in the vicinity, yet no Harvester seems to be anywhere in sight. Don’t get caught in the middle.
KeysToEntries.12F5292E46F272E7E728DAB9D508A5DE: Red alert, Raiders: we’ve spotted a Harvester in your area. A Queen is guarding it with her life; only engage if you've brought your best gear, lots of backup, and a very good plan.
KeysToEntries.7054630848C05DE1611964A6786F7742: You have eyes on a Queen? I'd... I'd run the other way as fast as you can.
KeysToEntries.A4C80FC24D7E37D2C9C66395BA19841E: A swarm of disoriented Wasps crashed near one of our skylights. I need you to help thin ARC's ranks before any more accidents happen, and gather some extra sturdy materials to fix the damage.
KeysToEntries.4C93EB3E4839A890AC586CB35937278E: Keep your eyes peeled, Raider; we have Field Depots scattered all around Topside. You're looking for makeshift structures with blue tarps and an antenna on top.
KeysToEntries.A8A27C454C6D6760F0C521B1CA712A41: That worked; thanks, Raider! My last engineer left some Hatch Keys nearby; feel free to grab them while you’re there.
KeysToEntries.8B77722247E55BA3869B9BBFC5BE82FC: Stay as long as you'd like in my presence, my new friend!
KeysToEntries.84F095794B8B8D1394033AA849F5DDD7: We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest. My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.
KeysToEntries.5B640706461CB871FDCC88975CAFFB84: Testing, testing; comms seems to be working! And hey, while you're there: Shani picked up a major rumble near your location. Do you see any sign of a collapse nearby?
KeysToEntries.637CB5934D95D8D6833317A8801860C2: Look for an outpost near the south part of the swamp. That's where I last remember having the journals. Please don't read 'em, though. Some... sensitive stuff in there.
KeysToEntries.5D16F7C44047DF5F89A841BD470A34A6: There it is. Honestly, you have no idea how happy that makes me. I hope people will see it and remember who we really are, and what we’re here for.
KeysToEntries.EBDED09A4862159575EAB9A0412EE382: Here’s a tip, Raider: Hornets tend to hover. If my designs hold up, that’s the perfect time to stick ‘em with an explosive or two.
KeysToEntries.F65536F14D9D5B92E45ECB9469C4A0CA: You'll have the best chance to find the materials I need around the industrial areas by The Dam. Stay safe out there, all right?
KeysToEntries.23B898194AB4A187434706860A01981D: Snap Blasts and Trigger ‘Nades will stick to surfaces, including those pesky Hornets.
KeysToEntries.1E71CFC0454A7CBE82ABEFB2287ED232: Here, take these latest designs. Without those Hornets ruining our day, we’ll stand a much better chance to fend off ARC.
KeysToEntries.A7BF3B064C1189B4944A9482C2F39471: Files received. Looks pretty damn juicy. Now, I just need to subtly drop the hint that I've got something they’d rather keep under wraps…
KeysToEntries.564EC62247254A6E38E15985FFCEC1B1: Our systems just lit back up, and the engineer's mumbling is getting more coherent by the minute. Thanks, Raider; get home safe.
KeysToEntries.839D22B94CC40E850C7B298D0479A512: Just a gentle reminder to keep an eye out for those salvage sites for Tian Wen; it may be just what we need to get her to pull her weight.
KeysToEntries.482B0F0A41FB1EE28FE9AA97AE43B27F: Primary power is back; so we're at least at half-grid. And one of our operators spotted the injured engineer crawling into one of our hatches.
KeysToEntries.2C83592A497E64739E303CB2A098AAF3: The power’s back on in sector F! Expect a lot of high fives, next time you’re there.
KeysToEntries.C55CEE374F239D2370F916929EC7D749: Generator works. Now find the power switch in the Ventilation Shaft. Look for a high tower; the switch should be under the stairs.
KeysToEntries.602C0A8D4164F8E3C2131F85D84F72D3: Hey, friend-o, picked up your frequency. Anyway, see to those medical supplies, and do try to come back in one piece — it makes my life a lot easier. Lance, out!
KeysToEntries.32F6D5ED47F37EFC9BAC42862EC11A68: Remember to grab as many goodies as you can from those medical facilities. Just resist the urge to sit on a hoard of syringes, OK?
KeysToEntries.92AFFD754C7E7C79C61AFCB7A7E8AD75: So: one pic from the southern tower near the Dam, one from the hospital roof in Buried City, and one from the Launch Towers by the Spaceport. Got it? Over and out.
KeysToEntries.41E9C7F84C3FB375E7CB92A4BF35AD90: Radio equipment seems to be working again; that should help us track ARC this side of the Rust Belt. Now get yourself to safety.
KeysToEntries.8D8D32BB404403B5D374B79ED7A8B70A: We’ve received your crate, Raider; we’ll see if this time’s finally the charm. Sent up some rewards for your efforts.
KeysToEntries.F8E9751E4B499C05ACC6598024A9C4EF: Raider: the leaking hatches should be marked on your map. We need them now more than ever, so patch one up before it breaks down all the way.
KeysToEntries.5FF8CE0042793C962D71979D1E1CE561: A Bombardier. Don’t think you’ll escape that one just by finding some cover.
KeysToEntries.C77BA3EA4825CC80A7D978AF60108D19: Don't forget that you can find different types of loot in different locations. Check out your map, and head to any of the spots I've marked with an icon.

KeysToEntries.5FDA0F874B377FC7E5CE4F9E5A51B3C9: A Spotter. It won’t harm you directly, but it’ll relay your location to others who most definitely will.
KeysToEntries.40609C824C37ACE197A855A228D1985A: A bunch of sensors started beeping over here, so the rewiring must’ve worked. That should keep my stashes safe from harm; good stuff.
KeysToEntries.F5796C99487BC166876177AE039623AF: Listening device is already picking up stray sounds, which means it’s working.

KeysToEntries.BD7776084A578A7985FC388765A41D18: An eye... That looks like his work, all right. He must be well, then. If anyone else communicated through cryptic drawings I’d be concerned, but from him… Anyway, thanks for helping out.

KeysToEntries.A1E80E294CD9FECC03F16E848FDA286E: If you can find a working salt battery prototype, we might just be able to reverse engineer the design.

KeysToEntries.584657E6421F5D1E15B1CCB23FD3E0E8: Now, I’m not saying ARC actually evolved like that; it’s only a pet theory for now. But I am trying to gather some internals so I can poke around for similarities. You in?
KeysToEntries.478CA71E404FC34EE5641BBC0E12289F: Thanks for gathering these up for me. I’ll see if I can figure out how these ARC parts relate, even if the tech is way above my pay grade.

KeysToEntries.2924288C4071EA60CBB9C8BC3B91BD92: You know what a Bastion is and what it does. Just make sure you don't slag the one thing I care about. Bring the cell back intact.

KeysToEntries.AC57B7BB4525EF0D6B3D6490FD04F8F7: Good. Start with one of the guard towers along the perimeter — they house the external sensors. Oh, bring batteries. These old systems are hungry.
KeysToEntries.71D382EE49F0847E0CFE6189B1E8C6A6: So. Someone wired a device into a sensor node, and they knew enough to keep the grid offline so it wouldn't trip. That's not scavenger work. That's someone who understands these systems. I'll look into it.

KeysToEntries.EEA14E4C4B8404D9CCC9BCA125066F8A: Alarm's gone. Grid's reading clean on my end. Well, as clean as century-old hardware gets. Whatever that was, you sorted it.

KeysToEntries.815857A84F847CA20F5C868A60D419BE: They were using the terminals there to relay logs back to me - I need you to retrace their steps.
KeysToEntries.B1251A1C47A3F2D86A97E89C70DFA87F: The scout team’s last confirmed position was one of the Field Depots east of the Spaceport. Find those logs, and send them my way - we’ll piece together where they went.
KeysToEntries.F79D1674459B8B09358746A10513C280: This is bad. The note outlines a deal. Names I recognize — people from the Ferrovia contrada. The scouts were feeding them patrol schedules, tube access codes; everything someone would need to undermine Celeste's authority.
